capabilities.name: Image preprocessing
capabilities.criterion: SAR per-tile normalization + speckle filter, zero/no-data masking, co-registration check, latitude-dependent pixel area; applied to all 1000 tiles
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Preprocessing log lists exactly 1000 processed tile IDs 1001-2000 and the area grid uses cos(lat); if fewer tiles or constant 100 m2 pixels, fail

capabilities.name: New-inundation recognition model
capabilities.criterion: Pixel-wise mask of new inundation produced for every tile by at least one physics baseline and one learned model

capabilities.name: Independent spatial validation
capabilities.criterion: Spatially blocked folds (clusters/longitude blocks); no tile shared between train and test
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Train/test tile ID sets disjoint in every fold and no test tile adjacent (<1.05 tile width) to a train tile in the same fold, or blocked by cluster; random pixel split => fail

capabilities.name: Pixel and area metrics
capabilities.criterion: OA, Precision, Recall, F1, IoU, kappa plus total new-area error, relative area error and tile MAE reported per fold and pooled
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Results JSON contains finite IoU and RAE computed from saved masks on held-out tiles; metrics only on training tiles or missing area metrics => fail

capabilities.name: FP/FN by land cover
capabilities.criterion: FP and FN area and their net effect on new-area estimate per land-cover stratum
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Table has >=3 land-cover strata, FP_area and FN_area per stratum summing to total FP/FN; single aggregate number only => fail

capabilities.name: Key accuracy factors
capabilities.criterion: Ranked drivers of tile area error with quantitative attribution (SHAP or regression)
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Driver ranking computed from tile-level held-out errors with an importance metric; qualitative list only => fail

capabilities.name: Label semantics verification
capabilities.criterion: Contingency of label x pre-water x SAR-dark computed on all pixels to justify F definition
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Statistic computed over all 1000 tiles (65.5M px); if computed on a sample or absent => fail

capabilities.name: Multi-source fusion improved model
capabilities.criterion: Fusion model (SAR+optical[+terrain/texture]) targeted at Q1 poor/uncertain cases evaluated on same folds as Q1

capabilities.name: Area error reduction
capabilities.criterion: Total |RAE| and tile MAE of new area compared with Q1 baseline on identical folds, with ablation
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Q1 and Q2 metrics computed on identical held-out tile sets; comparison across different splits => fail

capabilities.name: Intensity grading with explicit thresholds
capabilities.criterion: Four levels general/relatively strong/strong/extremely strong with strictly increasing proportion thresholds (and area thresholds) derived from data
capabilities.falsifiable_check: 0<t1<t2<t3<1 saved in results and derived by a documented data procedure (GMM/Jenks/quantile); hard-coded round numbers without derivation => fail

capabilities.name: Grade uncertainty analysis
capabilities.criterion: Grade-flip probabilities / grade confusion under area-error uncertainty
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Monte Carlo or analytic propagation of area error produces per-unit grade probabilities summing to 1; deterministic grade only => fail

capabilities.name: Area confidence interval
capabilities.criterion: Bias-corrected area with interval and empirical coverage on held-out tiles
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Empirical coverage of intervals on held-out tiles reported; interval without coverage check => fail

capabilities.name: Transfer Q2 model to Hengzhou
capabilities.criterion: Q2 model applied to Sentinel-1 with documented normalization / domain adaptation
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Hengzhou masks produced by the saved Q2 model (same weights) after documented intensity mapping; replacing it by an unrelated threshold only => fail

capabilities.name: Study area and imagery selection
capabilities.criterion: Study area and pre/during images with dates, coverage, processing stated
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Results record AOI area and image dates (06-27 pre; 07-04/07-16 flood) with coverage; missing dates => fail

capabilities.name: Pre-existing water and new inundation
capabilities.criterion: W0 and F rasters with F intersect W0 empty
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Saved rasters satisfy not any(F & W0) and F subset of W1; else fail

capabilities.name: New area, net increase, proportion
capabilities.criterion: A_new, A_net, rho per date with A_net<=A_new and rho=A_new/A_reg

capabilities.name: Spatial distribution map
capabilities.criterion: Georeferenced new-inundation raster saved for mapping

capabilities.name: Exposure data acquisition
capabilities.criterion: Population, built-up, roads, facilities proxies, terrain layers with source and year
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Each exposure layer listed with source/date and overlay computed with F; layers listed but not overlaid => fail

capabilities.name: Assessment units
capabilities.criterion: Explicit unit definition covering the study area
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Units partition the AOI (area sum within 1% of AOI); otherwise fail

capabilities.name: Comprehensive assessment model
capabilities.criterion: Unit index with hazard core (A_new, rho, grade) plus exposure, weights >=0 summing to 1, ranking and robustness

capabilities.name: Task choice and formulation
capabilities.criterion: Chosen task with decision time, objectives, demand method, resources, constraints stated
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Model file defines decision time, objective(s), demand formula, resources and constraints explicitly; missing any => fail

capabilities.name: Optimization solved
capabilities.criterion: MILP solved with status optimal (or gap reported) and all constraints satisfied in audit
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Constraint audit recomputes flow conservation, capacity, K and reachability from saved solution; any violation => fail

capabilities.name: Upstream results drive decisions
capabilities.criterion: Demand from Q4/Q3, road cuts and site exclusion from Q3 F
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Changing F (07-04 vs 07-16) changes the network/demand inputs and the solver is re-run; hard-coded demand independent of Q3/Q4 => fail

capabilities.name: Recommendation letter
capabilities.criterion: Letter covering remote sensing monitoring, information updates, resource allocation, implementation conditions and scope
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Letter contains all five elements tied to model results; generic advice without results => fail

capabilities.name: Assumption register and sensitivity
capabilities.criterion: Assumed parameters distinguished from observed data with impact analysis
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Each assumed parameter has a sensitivity result; assumptions without impact analysis => fail

capabilities.name: Overall model for the flood event
capabilities.criterion: Integrated chain Q1-Q5 delivered
capabilities.falsifiable_check: Q5 inputs trace to Q3/Q4 output files; otherwise fail
